title: BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2610.00092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. translated_title: BudgetSchemaBench：一种面向Text-to-SQL中模式上下文的预算扫描式诊断基准
translated_abstract: 基于结构化数据源的数据代理必须将数据库模式适配到模型的上下文窗口中。大型目录可能跨越多个数据库和数千个列，因此在上下文窗口被填满之前，成本约束可能就要求在表覆盖范围与序列化细节之间做出权衡。我们提出了BudgetSchemaBench，一个针对该场景的、基于执行结果的诊断基准。其构建过程从标准SQL（gold SQL）中机械地推导出相关性标签，无需人工或大语言模型编写的标注答案。我们使用一个汇集了80个数据库的目录，扫描四种模式上下文预算，并在保持各检索器表排序不变的情况下比较三种表示方式。源命名空间检查会拒绝那些从错误数据库中获得正确结果的查询。评估涵盖三种条件：端到端检索；冻结标准模式（frozen-gold），即保证所需表可用；以及移除这些表的探针测试。对于采用原始序列化的主要求解器，r（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: BudgetSchemaBench是一个基于执行结果的Text-to-SQL诊断基准，它从标准SQL中自动推导表相关性标签、在80个数据库的目录上扫描不同模式上下文预算并比较多种模式表示方式，从而系统评估了成本约束下表覆盖范围与序列化细节之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: BudgetSchemaBench is an execution-grounded diagnostic benchmark for Text-to-SQL that mechanically derives relevance labels from gold SQL, sweeps schema-context budgets over a pooled 80-database catalog, and compares schema representations to systematically evaluate the trade-off between table coverage and serialization detail under cost constraints.
